name: Oath of the Shield
blurb: The standard kit: hammers, shields, Sunbrand Libram.

name: Oath of Vengeance
blurb: Two Hammer Blows become Judgment and Templar's Verdict. The Ashen Libram burns brighter and costs you 5 HP.

name: Oath of Light
blurb: A Hammer Blow and a Raise Shield become Holy Shock and Flash of Light. The Beacon Libram heals after every fight.

name: Beastmaster
blurb: The standard kit, with the Wolf at your side.

name: Marksman
blurb: Two Arrows become Aimed Shot and Tracking. The Hawk marks what you shoot.

name: Survivalist
blurb: An Arrow and a Brace become Snake Trap and Camouflage. The Serpent poisons, and the worn whistle sends your Companion in before you draw.

name: Arcanist
blurb: The standard kit: three schools, Runed Focus.

name: Pyromancer
blurb: Two Arcane Bolts become Scorch and Fire Blast. The Ember Focus makes every Burn you apply deeper.

name: Cryomancer
blurb: Two Arcane Bolts become Frostbolt and Frost Nova. The Rime Focus makes every Chill you apply colder.
